div.head: Hn 61.12
div.ab: Et nemo iure possit irrecuperabiliter perdere uel forisfacere placitum domini sui; uiderit itaque cum quo agetur, si contracausator non ueniat, quem pro se mittat.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 582 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
